headlines.text: Looking back to 2023, when Mark Briscoe announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance against Jay Lethal, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.89 ? a genuine showstealer. Mark Briscoe made his emotional AEW debut against his brother's longtime rival Jay Lethal on what would have been Jay Briscoe's 39th birthday, winning with his late brother's own finisher, the Jay Driller, as the entire locker room emptied out to celebrate him.
That Saturday in 2025, King & Matthews left that name behind for good, stepping out as Hounds of Hell after 3 matches under the old identity, on Collision.

Turning the clock back to 2023: Darby Allin vs. Buddy Matthews fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.73. For Buddy Matthews, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: That Saturday in 2025, Konosuke Takeshita vs. Katsuyori Shibata closed out Collision, rated 7.94 ? a solid showing in a hard-fought men's division clash ? part of a stacked Homecoming '25 - Night 2 card, rated 8.44 overall.

On a Wednesday in 2023, back when Bryan Danielson reached a real marker of consistency: their 50th match in AEW, facing Bryan Danielson vs. Brian Cage on Dynamite, rated 7.08 ? a solid showing in a hard-fought men's division clash.
On a Wednesday in 2023, back when Andretti & Starks arrived in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.60.
